The '''Tintinna''', also known as '''T'iin-T'iin''' and '''Tin-Tin Dwarves''', were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] indigenous to [[Rinn/Legends|Rinn]]. Though most Tintinna remained on their primitive [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], others ventured into [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], some becoming valued members of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] crews.

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|I'm not a youngling, you know. I'm fifty three.|Meekerdin-maa|<ref name="DT1">[[Dark Times 1|''Dark Times'' 1]]</ref>}}
Tintinna were small (0.9 meters on average) and rodent-like. They possessed pink skin but were covered in brown fur. Their ears were small and round, and they had small black eyes. Their hands were dexterous and pink with four clawed digits. Tintinna had teeth typical of rodent species,<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species" /> and they had to spend at least part of their time gnawing in order to keep their teeth from growing too large and cumbersome.

The Tintinna temperament was typically pleasant; Tintinna were curious, amicable beings who could get along with most other species.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species" /><ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>

Some in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] believed the Tintinna to be related to the [[Ranat/Legends|Ranats]], due to their similar size and appearance.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species" />

==Society and culture==
[[File:RepublicTintinna.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A lone Tintinna in [[Ithaqua Station]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] planet of [[Toola/Legends|Toola]].]]
Tintinna lived on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Rinn/Legends|Rinn]], but their society was considered primitive by galactic standards. They lived in subterrannean burrows dug with only hands and feet. These nests were insulated by pieces of wood, leaves, and other materials. Tintinna in their native environment often smelled of wood chips. Without outside help, their technology advanced to the point of steam power.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species" /><ref name="NEGAS" />

The Tintinna divided themselves into many tribes. Each of these was ruled by a [[Chief/Legends|chief]] and a [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]]. These tribes lived in small settlements carved out from the mountains of their world. Tintinna farmers worked the countryside to feed the population, and traders carried goods and news from one settlement to another.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species" /><ref name="NEGAS" />

Because Rinn was located in a remote portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], Tintinna had little contact with the outside galaxy. Some offworlders used the planet as a hideout, and a few Tintinna left Rinn in their company. The Tintinna's natural curiosity allowed these explorers to adapt quickly to galactic technology. Many offworld Tintinna used their naturally keen senses to find work as lookouts. Those unfamiliar with the Tintinna often underestimated the creatures, mistaking them for pets or primitive simpletons.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species" /><ref name="NEGAS" />

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a Tintinna named [[Meekerdin-maa]] was a member of the crew of the transport ship, the ''[[Uhumele]]''. Meekerdin-maa, or "Ratty" as he was nicknamed, was present when the fugitive Jedi [[Dass Jennir]] stowed away aboard their ship. Ratty accompanied both Jennir and the ex-[[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Bomo Greenbark]] as they sought to rescue Greenbark's family from [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]]. When that mission failed, Jennir left the crew, who continued to experience a string of bad luck, having run-ins with dangerous [[Gangster/Legends|gangsters]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] himself. Ratty and the others eventually ended up on [[Kidron/Legends|Kidron]], where they met up with another Jedi fleeing the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] - [[Beyghor Sahdett]].

Later in the reign of the Empire, a Tintinna named [[Kit (Tintinna)|Kit]] was taken in by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], [[Shug Ninx]]. Ninx believed Kit to be nothing more than a non-sentient creature, and at first thought of him as a pet. Despite not giving Ninx any indication that he had met off-worlders before, Kit was able to organize all of Ninx's tools and made some repairs to his ship. As soon as Ninx discovered this, he realized his assumptions had been a mistake, and he took Kit on as a partner.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species" />

Another Tintinna named [[Squeak]]<ref name="complete">{{CSWECite|III|185|Squeak}}</ref> was present in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the fateful day when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] hired [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].<ref name="radio">{{SWRadio|The Han Solo Solution}}</ref>
